name: Organizing Block Demonstration on Polythene Mulch Technology in Groundnut
benefit: - **Financial Assistance:** An assistance of  ₹4,000/- towards the cost of inputs to organize the demonstration and  ₹4,000/- to cover the land with Polythene sheet per hectare will be provided.
_eligibility_text:
- The beneficiary should be a Farmer.
  - The beneficiary should be a resident of Tamil Nadu.
  - The beneficiary should produce and supply Foundation and Certified Class seeds to the Department.
